# Litigation Firm Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard gives litigation partners and practice managers a complete view of the firm's active caseload, attorney performance, win rates, and billing utilization. It supports strategic decisions on case intake, staffing, and settlement positioning.

## Key Metrics
- Active Cases: 84
- Cases Won Rate: 71.4%
- Billable Hours Utilization: 88.2%

## Insights
- Win rate has improved 4.2% year-over-year, driven by stronger pre-trial motion outcomes.
- Settlement rate of 62% is reducing average case duration; average time to resolution is down 18 days vs. prior year.
- Three attorneys are below 80% billable utilization — pipeline review recommended.
